notices.title: Lehi Planning Commission Notice of Public Hearings
notices.agenda_text:
On November 12, 2026, at 7:00 p.m. in the Lehi Civic Center Council Chambers located at 131 North 100 East, the Lehi City Planning Commission will hold a public hearing to receive public comment on the following items:
  
Public hearing and consideration of Grow Development's request for approval of the Morgan Lane Preliminary Subdivision, a 4-lot residential development located at 105 S 1100 W. 
 
Public hearing and recommendation of DR Horton's request for review of the Inverness Plat E grading permit including approximately 37 acres located at approximately Center Street and Traverse Terrace Drive. 
 
Public hearing and consideration of Kimley-Horn's request for approval of a conditional use permit for a drive-thru for the Lehi Chase Bank, located at 3850 West Hardman Way. 
 
Public hearing and recommendation Vaughn and Vicki Adams request for review of the Adams Zone Change on 1.099 acres located 455 North 900 East from RA-1 to R-1-Flex. 
 
Public hearing and consideration of Milton and Alayna Finau's request for approval of Finau Plat A combing lots 62 and 63 of Vista Ridge Phase 2 located at 184 West Crest Ridge.  
 
Public hearing and consideration of Albion Development's request for approval of a glass requirement exception for the Grow Industrial Site Plan located at 4218 W 1700 N. 
 
Public hearing and consideration of Jim and Teresa Strickland's request for conditional use approval of a flag lot located at 1918 North 600 West in the RA-1 zone. 
 
Public hearing and recommendation of Lehi City's request for review of a shared-use path replacing 3950 North and in lieu of the road connection to still meet connectivity requirements. 
 
Public hearing and recommendation of Lehi's City's request for review of Chapter 37 Development Code amendment adding Electric Vehicle Charging Station Standards.
 
Public hearing and consideration of EA Architecture's request for approval of a glass requirement exception for the Holbrook Farms 5 Church located at 3708 West 2600 North.

notices.title: Notice of Intent to Annex the Logan Annexation
notices.agenda_text:
PUBLIC NOTICE

LOGAN ANNEXATION
PUBLIC HEARING


On September 22, 2026, the Lehi City Council passed Resolution #2026-54 approving Lehi City's intent to annex approximately 2.68 acres of real property owned by Danny Logan, located at approximately 1300 South 1700 West, Lehi, Utah. 
A public hearing has been scheduled before the Lehi City Council on the 10th day of November, 2026, at 7:00 p.m. for the purpose of receiving public comment.  The public hearing will be held at the Lehi Civic Center, in the Council Chambers, located at 131 N. 100 E., Lehi, UT.  
The Lehi City Council will annex the above described parcel unless, at or before the public hearing, written protests to the annexation are filed by the owners of real property located within the area proposed for annexation covering a majority of the total private land area within the entire area proposed for annexation and also is equal to at least 1/2 the assessed value of all private real property within the entire area proposed for annexation.
